name: Kapka The Game
storyline: High above the clouds lies Tide Island, a magical place where nothing stays predictable for long. Players arrive to compete in a chaotic race around the island, collecting coins, discovering strange events and using powerful items against one another. Alliances may form, friendships may break, and the leader can change with a single roll of the dice.
summary: Kapka: The Game is an online multiplayer party board game for up to 10 players. Players take turns rolling dice and moving around a board, collecting coins, buying items, and triggering traps, teleports, and random events as they race to complete the required number of laps. Hosts can customize the match length and chaos level, and select between Classic and Halloween modes.
